source_notes: The prior build's own note is carried forward: an earlier assumption of 180 questions per FLK paper was corrected against the SRA's live pages to the real figure of 170 questions per paper (two sessions of 85, 2 hours 33 minutes each), five answer options, single best answer.

No fixed pass-percentage is published in advance; the SRA sets the cut score per sitting via a criterion-referenced standard-setting exercise against the 'day one competence' standard (commonly reported as Angoff-based in secondary sources, not stated as an exact formula on the SRA's own pages). This course therefore grades tests on correct-option-plus-reasoning, not a memorised numeric cut score.

Both FLK1 and FLK2 pages were fetched in full for this itemisation on 2026-09-22 and every subject sub-heading is represented; where the SRA's own page groups several closely related sub-bullets under one heading (e.g. several Theft Act sections, or several PACE Code provisions), this course sometimes teaches them as one item rather than one item per sub-bullet, to keep items at the level of an examinable content statement rather than a citation list -- flagged here rather than silently done.
